text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: TIC-80 is a fantasy computer designed for creating and playing small retro-style games. It recreates the limitations of classic consoles with a fixed resolution, limited color palette, sprite tools, music creation, and built-in development tools. Games are distributed as digital cartridges and can be created using languages including Lua, JavaScript, and Wren. TIC-80 is inspired by classic home computers and modern indie game development tools.
